Metadata.title: GetFit
Metadata.description: A structured programme that combines strength training and running, with recovery built in.

Landing.title: GetFit
Landing.tagline: Strength training and running, together in one structured programme.
Landing.subtitle: Every day, know what to do, why it matters and when to recover.

checkInbox.title: Check your inbox
checkInbox.body: If {email} can be used, we have sent a confirmation link to it. Open it to activate your account.
checkInbox.hint: The link works on any device. Check your spam folder if nothing arrives within a few minutes.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email address first, using the link we sent you.
errors.weakPassword: This password is too easy to guess. Choose another one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.invalidLink: This link has expired or was already used. Log in, or sign up again to get a new one.
errors.invalidInput: Check the fields and try again.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.
errors.samePassword: Choose a password different from your current one.

resetPassword.title: Reset your password
resetPassword.intro: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
resetPassword.sentBody: If an account uses {email}, we have sent it a link to choose a new password. The link works on any device.

updatePassword.title: Choose a new password
updatePassword.intro: You will stay signed in on this device. Your other devices will be signed out.
updatePassword.doneBody: Use your new password the next time you log in. Your other devices have been signed out.

error.title: Your profile could not be loaded
error.body: Check your connection, then try again.

States.errorBody: We couldn’t load this page. Check your connection and try again.
